title: Madma milaagteh tan xayyos
intro: seehadayti baxi naharsi ayroora, rooci acwa xayyoysam saytun niya luk. takkay immay, aysinu oggol silaalak addat rade. Ta muucih aydaadu gey, kay diini kee cuzni ellecabo qibaadah maybalaalaqah addat rabe wayte.
clues: Anu seehadayti baxi qemmoh horah fanat suge.
Anu xayyoseh fida yi Rabbih, kee toh racmatta luk hirigte.
Yi toobokoytih fida cinnimteh, kee aysinu kay sorkocô baxat dattooweh.
Anu kaah warseh, 'Atu isi gaba yoo fanah fidga haytek, anu inni gaba koo qiduh mafiyyo; nummaak anu Yallak meysitah, baad rabbik.'
Anu ardi bagul qimbô qidimih abtoh madluum ekke.
Yi qabli weeqeh, kee anu naharsi shahiid suge.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: Kay fida oggolimteh, kay toobokoytih aysinu kee kay qidimih sabab
Usug girah laqnat qiden takkay immay biyaakiteh yewqeh
Usug qibaadah miracsental kaxxa markab xise
Usug kaxxa kullumti yanxuqeeh ditet raaqeh
Usug isi ummatta baxsime badih addat miraacise
trial.answer: Kay fida oggolimteh, kay toobokoytih aysinu kee kay qidimih sabab

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Aydaadul qimbô qidim; kay toobokoyti nacsimeh
outcome.answer: Aydaadul qimbô qidim; kay toobokoyti nacsimeh

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
